name: Skeleton
summary: Layout-preserving placeholder painted while content loads. Renders the shape of the eventual content — text lines, avatars, cards, table rows — using a faint shimmer that pauses under prefers-reduced-motion. Use for first-paint loads; never combine with a Spinner on the same surface (one signal at a time).

shape.description: text: line of text. circle: avatar / dot. rect: button / chip / image. card: full card body (composed of header + lines). row: table row.

width.description: CSS length. Defaults: text=100%, circle=40px, rect=auto, card=full container, row=full row.

height.description: CSS length. Defaults: text=1em line-height-based, circle=40px, rect=24px, card=auto, row=44px.

lines.description: shape='text' only. Render N lines with random-feeling widths (the last line is 60-80% to mimic prose).

radius.description: Override default radius. 'inherit' uses the contextual default per shape.

shimmer.description: When true, the shimmer translateX animation runs at 1.6 s / ease-in-out. False renders a static dim block (operator dashboards that load < 200 ms — flash of shimmer feels worse than no shimmer at all).

rules: Skeletons are decorative. role='presentation' (or simply aria-hidden='true'). The parent surface should set aria-busy='true' and announce the loading state once via a sr-only label.
Shimmer animation MUST pause under prefers-reduced-motion. Without shimmer the block stays as a dim surface so the layout is preserved.
Skeletons must match the eventual content's bounding box to within ~10% — otherwise the page jumps on load.

do: Use skeletons for predictable layouts you can mock (table rows, card grids, profile headers).
Use shape='text' lines=3 for paragraph stubs.
Set aria-busy='true' on the parent surface; announce 'Loading' once via sr-only.
Match the eventual bounding box. A dashboard card skeleton should be the same height as the loaded card.
dont: Don't combine Skeleton with Spinner on the same surface.
Don't paint shimmer with the brand accent — chrome, not action.
Don't render a skeleton that shifts layout when content arrives.
Don't skeleton everything — for a single line of text, a Spinner inline is less visually noisy.

changelog.note: Initial Skeleton contract. Five shape variants. Reduced-motion-safe shimmer.
